comments.body:
I think that a more concise way to word this might be:

_Verify that the application never automatically fills in or saves a user's plaintext credentials–either as hidden or visible form fields, query parameters, cookie values, or HTTP headers._ 

I don't think it is necessary to explain why (this isn't done with other items) and I don't think it's really necessary to say that cryptographic nonces are allowed.
